newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech insurer sells cable stake to US West.
newsitem.headline: Czech insurer sells cable stake to US West.

text.p: Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s. said on Wednesday it had sold a 36.11 percent stake in Czech cable television operator Kabel Plus to US West Czech Cable Co.
It said in a statement that the stake was worth a nominal 550 million crowns but declined to reveal the actual price.
US West took a minority stake in Kabel Plus in 1995 when the cable network was controlled by Ceska Pojistovna. But the U.S. company increased its stake to 57 percent during the summer this year.
